answer: Conductance detection resists sybils: honest identities form a well-connected core, but a sybil region attaches through only a few attestation edges, so the graph cut between them is thin — a copper seam in walnut. Trust that must wander across that narrow bottleneck to reach the fakes is throttled at the cut. A thousand sybils behind a handful of edges inherit almost no weight, however densely they vouch among themselves.
